races.verdict: COASTING is given a chance to build on his promising 7f course second earlier in the month. Willie McCreery's Bella Colombia caught the eye at Leopardstown recently and this former C&D scorer is second choice. Moyassr 's good C&D record brings him into the reckoning, while the selection's stablemate Gavoo is well treated if a return to all-weather sparks a revival. COASTING (IRE) BELLA COLOMBIA (IRE) MOYASSR (IRE)

races.verdict: Three-time C&D winner UNA MATATA is very well treated on her form here earlier in the year and having produced her best effort for some time when third over C&D 12 days ago, she could well be ready to strike. Leannespour remains pretty lightly raced and isn't one to be writing off from her basement mark, whilst Expound finds himself operating from a career-low mark if bouncing back over this shorter trip. Roman Harry completes the shortlist. UNA MATATA (IRE) LEANNESPOUR (IRE) EXPOUND

races.display_title: Host Your Conference At Huntingdon Racecourse Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: SERAPHIC was suited by the emphasis on speed when recording a first hurdles win on these shores at Stratford recently, but he still did well to come from last and looks capable of defying a 6 lb higher mark providing this doesn't come too soon just 11 days on. Gallivanted should strip fitter for his recent run and make more of an impact in this weaker affair, while Zafaan shouldn't be judged too harshly on his latest effort on the level and remains of interest back over hurdles. SERAPHIC (IRE) GALLIVANTED (FR) ZAFAAN (IRE)
